name: E-commerce baseline
description: Ten things a typical shopper (or their AI agent) tries to find on a retail site before buying.

tasks.task: What is the return policy, and how many days do I have to return an item?
Do you ship to Switzerland, and what does it cost?
How long does standard delivery take?
Which payment methods do you accept?
How can I contact customer support, and when are you available?
How do I track my order?
Do products come with a warranty or guarantee, and for how long?
Where is the size guide or product specifications?
Are there any current discounts, promo codes or a first-order offer?
Do you have physical stores, and where?
